thread:
pagerduty-bot: P1 page — az1a: elevated inference 5xx + p95 latency spike. Automatic alerts: nat/gateway conntrack high, ENI detach events. Please acknowledge.

eric_oncall: acked. I'm on it — joining. linking runbook `runbook/az-egress-deg`.

marta_cs: seeing customer reports: ~15% 502s for EU region hitting az1a, many users retry and succeed, a few support tickets opened.

sam_sre: infra signals: gateway-az1a-2 conntrack ~95% and kernel drop logs: `nf_conntrack: table full`, ENI detach/flap around same window.

infra-bot: resolver latency spike observed starting 1718807600, TTL refresh traffic increased x4. DNS cache churn likely amplifying upstream NAT connections.

priya_infra: starting mitigation plan: 1) enable cross-AZ routing fallback 2) spin up extra NAT gateway in az1b 3) temporary traffic steering off az1a (gradual). Will move 20% first.

eric_oncall: paste the exact commands you plan to run and any expected impact.

priya_infra: running steer now — command: ```redwoodctl traffic steer --from-zone az1a --to-zone az1b --weight 20 --mode gradual``` Expect p95 to drop in ~60-120s for routed requests.

sam_sre: kicking off NAT create: `aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-az1b-xxx` (will take ~3-6m). Also increasing conntrack max temporarily on affected hosts: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and rolling.

eric_oncall: noted. Applying conntrack bump on a small subset first. Post any errors here.

priya_infra: steering to 50% now (no binary flips) — monitoring.

sam_sre: observing immediate improvement on p95 for steered traffic. ENI detach rate down after conntrack bump. NAT create succeeded, we attached gw to public subnet in az1b.

lin_sre: enabling model fallback on the inference route to reduce per-instance tail latency while we stabilize: `routes.update("/generate", { model_fallback: true, fallback_model: "gpt-medium-quant" })` This will lower token-per-second for some requests but reduce tail.

eric_oncall: good call. Apply and watch quality metrics. Marta, do we need to queue a customer note?

marta_cs: I'll draft a short banner for affected customers and flag any enterprise accounts with sustained errors. Will post after 10m if errors still >=5%.

ops-manager: good run. Keep the channel clear of chatter; paste metrics and next steps only. If impact persists beyond 30m, escalate to network lead.

priya_infra: current metrics: global p95 for az1a-bound requests went from 920ms -> 210ms for steered traffic; overall 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 2.3%. Routing change and conntrack bump are the main wins.

eric_oncall: confirmed. We'll keep the fallback and NAT as active until peak. I'll hand off to lin_sre for overnight watch in 45m.

lin_sre: I'll take the handoff. Please leave any follow-ups in this thread. I'll run a deeper check on ENI attach logs and file an action item to tune conntrack permanently or move flows to a managed NAT solution.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged. On-call handoff scheduled to lin_sre at 1718811377.

eric_oncall: incident update summary: cause = NAT/conntrack saturation + DNS cache churn in az1a leading to ENI flaps and packet drops; mitigations applied = conntrack increase, cross-AZ traffic steering (~50%), spawn nat-gw in az1b, enable model fallback. Impact reduced, customers improving. We'll open a postmortem and action items. Closing active pager.

marta_cs: thanks team — I'll coordinate any follow-ups with affected customers and include timeline.

ops-manager: add action: (1) review conntrack defaults (2) automated early steer on conntrack threshold (3) improve DNS cache headroom monitoring. Assign owners in follow-up doc.

priya_infra: filing task now. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321

eric_oncall: thanks all, marking as resolved for now. Will keep watch for 1hr then move to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
